title: Elder's Test
next_chapter_hook: On the night before Chen Ji was about to investigate Zhang Shen's background in depth, an anonymous secret letter quietly appeared beside his pillow—containing only four characters, yet it suddenly changed the chess game that had seemed so clear to him.

text.content: When the symbol, similar to the patterns of the Tianji Record, was branded onto Chen Ji's palm, he suddenly realized—the mysterious benefactor's scheme might have begun long ago. The brand on his palm faintly burned, as if reminding him that every piece on the chessboard was being quietly moved by someone. And he—was he the chess player, or merely a discarded piece on someone else's board?

In the early morning at Tianqing Sect, the thin mist had yet to disperse. Chen Ji, as usual, was chopping wood at the Servants' Quarters, his movements sluggish and expression blank—just like a waste of a disciple whose edges had been worn smooth by life. Only he himself knew that behind those lowered eyes, every possibility was being rapidly calculated. The brand on his palm had faded, but that feeling of being watched was like a bone-deep disease, impossible to shake off.

dialogue.emotion: 温和却带着不容拒绝的威严

text.content: A hoarse yet commanding voice rang out at the entrance of the Servants' Quarters. Chen Ji looked up to see an elderly man in a dark blue elder's robe standing with hands clasped behind his back. It was Zhang Shen—one of the four great elders of Tianqing Sect. On the surface, he was the elder in charge of outer disciple affairs, but in reality, he was closely aligned with the sect master's faction. Chen Ji's heart tightened slightly, but his face showed a flattered and overwhelmed expression as he fumbled to put down the axe and scurried over.

dialogue.content: Zhang Shen stroked his flowery white beard, squinting as he examined the trembling youth before him with an air of "concern": "I hear, child, that when you were on duty at the scripture archive yesterday, you accidentally knocked over a bookshelf? You didn't hurt yourself, did you?"

text.content: Chen Ji laughed coldly in his heart. This Elder Zhang never bothered with servant disciples on ordinary days, yet today he was actively "concerned" about a废物—a clearly motivated move. But his face displayed only terrified deference as he waved his hands repeatedly: "Thank you for your concern, Elder. I just... I just felt a bit dizzy, it's nothing serious, nothing serious..."

dialogue.content: Zhang Shen nodded, a flash of sharp light vanishing from his eyes before he resumed his kindly appearance: "Young man, the body is the foundation of cultivation. Very well, you don't need to be on duty today. Come with this old man to the side hall for some tea. This old man has some questions about cultivation he'd like to ask you."

choice.prompt: How should Chen Ji respond to Zhang Shen's invitation?

choices.description: Pretend to be an overwhelmed waste of a disciple, follow Zhang Shen to the side hall, and cooperate with his probing performance
choices.visible_reward: Opportunity to observe Zhang Shen's true intentions up close
choices.risk_hint: The old fox may see through him

text.content: Chen Ji hastily bowed and scraped, his eyes full of gratitude: "Elder honors me beyond my deserving..." He lowered his head, but the corners of his lips curved slightly upward—the fish had taken the bait.

choices.description: Pretend physical discomfort or having matters to attend to, refuse Zhang Shen's invitation, and avoid this test for now
choices.visible_reward: Buy time to investigate Zhang Shen's background

text.content: Chen Ji's face showed a troubled expression: "I appreciate the Elder's kindness, but... I still have several bundles of firewood left to chop today. If the steward blames me..."

A barely perceptible gleam flashed in Zhang Shen's eyes before he smiled: "Let someone else handle the firewood. An invitation to tea from this old man is a great matter. Who would dare object?" With that, he turned and walked toward the side hall, his pace neither fast nor slow, yet carrying an irresistible pressure. Chen Ji followed with his head lowered, but in his heart he was rapidly calculating: What does this Elder Zhang really want from him?

Inside the side hall, tea fragrance curled. Zhang Shen sat at the host's seat and personally poured a cup of tea for Chen Ji, his posture as caring as an elder concerned for a younger generation. However, when Chen Ji took the teacup with both hands, he keenly sensed the other's fingers trembling slightly—a subtle reaction that occurs only with emotional fluctuations. The test had begun from this moment.

dialogue.content: Zhang Shen raised his teacup and took a light sip, asking as if casually: "Chen Ji, you've been in the sect for several years now. Have you ever heard about your father Chen Xuan? Back in the day, he was quite the... remarkable figure in Tianqing Sect."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart jolted violently. The moment his father's name was mentioned, he almost thought he'd been discovered. But years of restraint had long taught him how to perfectly mask his emotions. He blinked blankly, confusion spreading across his face: "My father's... affairs? Disciple... disciple isn't quite sure. When I entered the sect, the steward only said I was an orphan, with no other explanation..."

dialogue.content: Zhang Shen stared into his eyes, as if searching for some flaw: "Oh? Your father was once the number one genius of Tianqing Sect, his cultivation reaching the heavens—only later... what a pity." He sighed. "This old man was also an old acquaintance of his. Seeing you today, I can't help but recall the past. Do you know that the things your father left you are far more than you realize?"

choice.prompt: Zhang Shen speaks with hidden meaning. How should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: Act completely unable to understand, respond with the mindset of a废物 disciple, thoroughly dispel the other's guard
choices.visible_cost: May seem overly stupid and arouse suspicion
choices.visible_reward: Let the other lower their guard

text.content: Chen Ji showed an even more dazed expression, scratching his head: "Father... left something for disciple? Disciple really doesn't know..." He looked at Zhang Shen with adoring yet fearful eyes, "Elder, what else did Father leave? Can disciple... can disciple exchange it for elixirs?"

choices.text: Pretend to be afraid and probe further
choices.description: Show fear and avoidance about past matters, probe how much the other actually knows
choices.visible_cost: May expose attachment to father's past
choices.visible_reward: Draw out the snake—let the other voluntarily reveal more information
choices.risk_hint: The other may seize the opportunity to extract information

text.content: Chen Ji's face paled slightly, his voice trembling: "Father's affairs... disciple really doesn't want to mention them anymore. Over these years since entering the sect, others have whispered behind my back, saying disciple is... is a criminal's son..." He lowered his head, hands tightly gripping the corners of his robe, "Elder, do... do you know something?"

dialogue.content: Zhang Shen narrowed his eyes, as if judging whether Chen Ji's reaction was genuine. After a moment, he set down his teacup, his tone becoming meaningful: "Enough, let's not speak of past matters. This old man is simply curious—you're a servant disciple who can barely feed himself, how have you managed to survive until now? Could it be... that you've encountered some fortuitous opportunity?"

text.content: This question was extremely tricky. If Chen Ji said no, the other might grow suspicious—how could a nothing废物 survive so many years in a scheming cultivation world? If he admitted to having encountered opportunities, he would fall right into the other's trap. Chen Ji冷笑ed in his heart, but on his face he showed a bitter smile: "Elder jokes with me. With disciple's spiritual roots, what opportunity could there possibly be... surviving until now is simply luck."

dialogue.content: Zhang Shen stared at him for a long while, then suddenly laughed: "Good, good, just lucky." He stood up and patted Chen Ji's shoulder. "Alright, let's leave it at that for today. If you have any difficulties, feel free to come find this old man."

text.content: Chen Ji hastily stood and bowed, his posture respectful to the extreme. The moment he turned to leave, he suddenly sensed a cold murderous intent flash across his back. The killing intent was extremely hidden—if not for his years of walking on eggshells, he would never have detected it. But Chen Ji's footsteps didn't pause in the slightest, still that timid, cringing demeanor, as if noticing nothing. After leaving the side hall, a cold smile curled at his lips—sure enough, this old fox was no善类.

He knew his废物 persona was temporarily safe. But Zhang Shen's probing about father's affairs and questioning about opportunities today clearly indicated suspicion. And that fleeting murderous intent made Chen Ji almost certain—this Elder Zhang was absolutely involved in the matters of years ago. The clues were gradually connecting, but Chen Ji knew it wasn't yet time to close the net. He needed more evidence, needed to thoroughly understand this old fox's bottom line. Until then, he had to keep playing the role he knew best—a ignorant废物.

On the night before Chen Ji was about to investigate Zhang Shen's background in depth, an anonymous secret letter quietly appeared beside his pillow—containing only four characters, yet it suddenly changed the chess game that had seemed so clear to him.
